title: Carmina Latina Epigraphica (Bücheler 1895–97; Lommatzsch 1926); RU «Латинские эпиграфические стихотворения»; pilot: verse epitaphs
author: Anonymous Latin verse inscriptions
edition: Bücheler, Anthologia Latina II.1–2 (Teubner 1895–97, public domain, archive.org); Engström 1912 supplement (public domain); Lommatzsch 1926
ru_evidence: Only single poems in articles, e.g. «Метрическая эпитафия Луция Калидия Эротика» (ИЯКФ 2014, CyberLeninka). No collection found.
en_evidence: Courtney, Musa Lapidaria (1995): 204 poems with facing English translation (BMCR 1998.03.12), i.e. under 10% of CLE.
other_translations: Regional CLE corpora with Spanish/Italian translations exist (extent not checked)
value: The largest body of non-literary Latin poetry: family feeling, social values, reception of Virgil and Ovid, Vulgar Latin and metrics. Excellent for Latin teaching; Russian readers have no anthology.
ai_feasibility: high for sense. Medium for metre, Vulgar spellings and Bücheler's supplements; check against CIL/EDCS.
pilot_unit: 150 verse epitaphs from Rome (CLE sepulcralia), est. 1,200 lines; alternative: the Pompeian carmina
